claim: Action requirements may determine which historical predicates remain useful and which require revalidation; test actual control benefit over strong public rules.
checkpoint: existing EventVLA RoboTwin-MeM; verify hash and native task compatibility before run
candidate_selection: first qualifying states in fixed task/seed/time order; record all exclusion reasons; no outcome-based replacement
primary_measure: actual executed control error and paired continuation outcome, not retrieval image hit
diagnostic_branches: same-width evidence selected from legal pre-decision observed history by an evaluator, diagnostic only
best applicable nonlearned public evidence/state baseline selected without paired branch outcomes
candidate_baselines: complete compact history if it fits deployment input budget
fixed-prompt evidence sufficiency check with full cost accounting
required_pairing: same physics parent, current observations, instructions and anchor inputs
same event count, positions and timestamp handling; document evidence replacements
RNG indexed by paired policy request rather than elapsed physical time
no hidden original history or stale action chunk bypass
oracle annotations stay in evaluator and diagnostic upper bound
count full inference, retrieval and physical reobservation costs
training_entry: reproducible native control failures attributable to evidence use
better legal evidence changes actual paired control outcomes
strong public baselines leave a concrete unresolved case pattern
positive and negative evidence cases within the same query kind and task stage
state a specific distinction from closest published methods
stop_when: setup session limit or rollout limit reached without interpretable evidence
only proxy retrieval errors but no control consequence
better evidence does not repair control failures
simple public state rules or full small archive cover observed cases
interpretation: Development decision only. No power or publication claim from these small samples. Original K/R labels are not evidence-validity labels.
